prompt: Create a vertical 2:3 digital artwork of a surreal bowl of ramen rendered as smooth, inflated, clay-like 3D forms with a vivid rainbow gradient glow on a pure black background. The main subject is one large ramen bowl viewed from a high three-quarter angle, centered and filling most of the canvas, with thick rounded rim and small foot base. Use saturated neon color transitions across every surface: hot pink, coral orange, golden yellow, lime green, teal, cyan, cobalt blue, and violet, with soft studio lighting and velvety matte material. Inside the bowl, include exactly 7 visible food element groups: 1 large square sheet at the back like nori or tofu, leaning diagonally upward; 3 overlapping spiral fish-cake-like slices on the left; 1 spiral slice near the rear center; 2 halved egg-like ovals on the right with concentric yolk centers; 1 cluster of about 12 round green peas or beans in the center; 1 set of thick curled noodle loops across the front; and 1 set of small rounded broth/topping lumps partially visible under the noodles. Make the ramen look intentionally strange and not very appetizing, like colorful toy food or soft polymer clay rather than realistic food. Add subtle shadowing inside the bowl and a luminous rim highlight, with no text except a small handwritten artist signature and date in the bottom-right corner reading July 27, 2026 Oyagi. Customize the food as ramen, keep the background black, use a neon rainbow gradient, and maintain the smooth inflated matte 3D clay.

promptZh: 创作一幅 2:3 竖构图的数字艺术作品，描绘一碗超现实的拉面，采用光滑、膨胀的黏土质感 3D 形式渲染，并在纯黑色背景上呈现出生动的彩虹渐变光泽。主体是一个从高处四分之三视角俯瞰的大拉面碗，居中并占据大部分画布，碗口厚实圆润，底部有小底座。在每个表面使用高饱和度的霓虹色过渡：亮粉色、珊瑚橙、金黄色、青柠绿、蓝绿色、青色、钴蓝色和紫罗兰色，配合柔和的摄影棚灯光和天鹅绒般的哑光材质。碗内需包含 7 组清晰可见的食物元素：后方有一片类似海苔或豆腐的大方片，呈对角线向上倾斜；左侧有 3 片重叠的螺旋状鱼板切片；后方中心附近有 1 片螺旋切片；右侧有 2 片对半切开的蛋状椭圆，带有同心圆蛋黄；中心有一簇约 12 颗圆形的青豆或豆类；前方有一组厚实卷曲的面条；以及一组部分隐藏在面条下的小块肉汤或配料。让拉面看起来刻意怪异且不太有食欲，更像是色彩鲜艳的玩具食物或软陶，而非写实食物。在碗内添加微妙的阴影和明亮的边缘高光，除右下角一行手写艺术家签名和日期外，不包含任何文字，内容为 July 27, 2026 Oyagi。自定义食物为 ramen，保持背景为 black，使用 neon rainbow gradient，并保持 smooth inflated matte 3D clay 的材质风格。
